sd_convention: sd_population divides by n (statistics.pstdev); sd_sample divides by n-1 (statistics.stdev). Both are in the units of the statistic (microseconds); a single value reports 0.0 for both.
note: intervals are host-capture-point (same parent-NIC clock), not ASIC forwarding time; timestamps are integer microseconds at the capture resolution
